analyses.objective: Complete broad search over both legal king moves to compare Kc2-capture vs Kf1-f2 retreat before committing.

quiescence.scope: Captures, promotions and all legal check evasions; static boundary at the depth limit

analyses.score_scope: Bounded main search plus quiescence estimate; depth boundaries are approximate, not game proofs

analyses.objective: Verify Kf2 as the commit move, confirming the king stays safe from Black's rook checks and that White keeps the extra material.

quiescence.scope: Captures, promotions and all legal check evasions; static boundary at the depth limit

analyses.score_scope: Bounded main search plus quiescence estimate; depth boundaries are approximate, not game proofs

safety.scope: All immediate Black replies checked for mate in one only

tactical_refutation.scope: Checking Black replies, every White defense, then Black mate in one; quiet replies and longer mates not covered

checking_chain_refutation.scope: Continuous Black checks up to mate in three; every White evasion covered. Quiet threats and longer mates not covered

move_facts.attack_scope: Geometric attacks by the moved piece after this move, including defended own pieces; not a proof of legal continuations
